structure_policy.fragment_rule: retain a single carbon-containing fragment; quarantine zero or multiple carbon-containing fragments
structure_policy.identity: canonical isomeric SMILES; preserve isotopes and specified stereochemistry
structure_policy.uncharging: sensitivity grouping only, not primary identity
structure_policy.ambiguous_structure_for_same_source_id: quarantine all records for the ID

measurement_policy.eligibility: reuse the saved discovery criteria and numerical record_signal implementation
measurement_policy.cross_threshold_disagreement: retain records; quarantine compound from provisional usable set
measurement_policy.bounds: retain inequalities; review incompatible bounds or exact-versus-bound disagreement
measurement_policy.unknown_records: retain separately; never convert to nonhit
measurement_policy.activity_annotation_disagreement: review inactive/inconclusive annotation alongside numerical hit support
measurement_policy.exact_measurement_spread: report fold range; no automatic averaging or rejection

diversity_policy.scaffolds: Bemis-Murcko; report exact and generic scaffolds, without stereochemistry

qualification: review pending; no automatic pass/fail based on diversity heuristics
